en: Black‑and‑white image of a landscaped park with curving paths and dense trees framing a large, ornate stone monument. The monument features a central standing female figure on a tall pedestal, with seated allegorical figures around the base and circular medallions or reliefs. Behind the trees, a church or town‑hall–like building with a clock on its tower and a tall spire rises in the background. The scene is formal and symmetrical, typical of an early 20th‑century city park postcard. Any inscriptions on the monument are too small and blurred to read.
